gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically-confirmed glioblastoma (WHO Grade IV glioma); tumors situated primarily in the infratentorial compartment will be excluded.

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will receive paxalisib starting at a dose of 45 mg/day.
Patients will receive metformin on Cycle 1, Day 1 at a starting dose of 850 mg QD

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This study is for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma, as well as patients who have recurring glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Change in tumor glucose uptake values: Measured by FDG-PET/DCE MRI
Change in insulin levels: Evaluated by the mean and standard deviation of values over time

role_evidence.quote: a new blood-brain penetrant PI3K/mTOR inhibitor (paxalisib) combined with a ketogenic diet plus metformin

arms: Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma
Arm 2: Recurrent glioblastoma, regardless of methylation status

role_evidence.quote: Metformin (a drug approved by the Food and Drug Administration to treat type 2 diabetes), and to see what effects it has on glioblastoma.

arms: Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma
Arm 2: Recurrent glioblastoma, regardless of methylation status

source_quote.quote: Demonstrated unmethylated MGMT promotor status confirmed by validated PCR or alternate genomic analysis

arms: Arm 1: Newly diagnosed MGMT unmethylated glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: Patients with tumors exhibiting mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase-1 or 2 (IDH-1, 2).

coder_notes: Ketogenic diet is a registered intervention but is a diet (excluded intervention type, not a drug), so not listed as an agent. Paxalisib and metformin are both investigational in the experimental arms. Target engagement coded unclear: tumour glucose uptake (FDG-PET) and insulin are measured as secondary outcomes but are not explicitly linked to a candidate or its target. IDH-mutant tumours are excluded (implicit IDH-wildtype requirement), so cns5 coded.
